items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: Yeah, I liked Leonard in those days. He was a wonderful fellow... Well, that was before my time.

ctx.x: But, uh... Do you remember Jimmy Boisot, H.J. Boisot? He used to own a printing company. He played wonderful ragtime piano.
Well, you know, you never mentioned, don't know who I never mentioned, a fellow by the name of Bosdorfer. He was very young. Leonard? Leonard Bosdorfer.
I knew Johnny, but I never knew Leonard.
